title: The SDE-2 Interview Loop
description: Pass the Tier-1 SDE-2 loop end to end: the round-by-round playbook, coding strategy & communication, the system-design round (trade-offs, SDE-2 vs SDE-3 leveling), behavioral/STAR & leadership principles, company-specific prep (Grafana, Uber, Atlassian, Razorpay, PhonePe, Microsoft), and the offer & negotiation (comp structure, levels, India vs international, counteroffers) — with timed coding drills and structured deliverables.
